<!-- A failing `go generate` must abort the render, not land on the slide. The directive calls a tool that is not in the module, so the case needs no network. -->

```{.go .run .test .output .go-generate}
package main

import "testing"

//go:generate go tool mockgen -source=main_test.go -destination=mock_test.go -package=main

func TestNothing(t *testing.T) {}
```
